# VLESS-Reality inbound, the shape that produces every usable log_events row.
# sing-box renders these with log.Formatter using timestamp format
# "-0700 2006-01-02 15:04:05" and colors enabled, which is what BoxFleet's
# rendered configs (log.timestamp = true, no disable_color) emit to journald.
# The literal two-character sequence \x1b stands for a real ESC byte.
# Lines starting with # are comments and are not fed to the parser.

# field appears as "0ms", "1.50s" and "2m30s" on the same node.
